name: com.hawkes.analytics
description: Hawkes Analytics for Unity WebGL games: HawkesAnalytics.Track/Screen/SetContext/LevelStart/LevelEnd/Death/Feedback/Ask call window.hawkesAnalytics in the page, and load Hawkes Gen's SDK there when the page hasn't (product from Resources/HawkesAnalyticsSettings). In the Editor and outside WebGL it only logs. Runtime package; the game's website needs no change.

samples.description: A scene with three buttons that send events and an on-screen list of what was sent. Open Basic events > HawkesAnalyticsSample.unity.
